biography.bio:
An ex-con and Mayhem's most dependable enforcer; gruff, mean and very good at his job.

Masks: Stiletto, Sawblade (wearing Stiletto).

Vehicles: @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.E4wNrTycQcmyTsdV]{Piranha}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.VRY1hD0KU2Bad2YX]{Piranha Sidecar Sub}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.tU1LF3mK9IFMXaR1]{Pitstop Catapult}.

V.E.N.O.M. - M.A.S.K. homebrew; stats built with the Threat Builder (Field Guide rules).

system.description:
Fires a spray of spinning blades.

Sly Rax's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls Targeting against the Evasion of up to two targeted creatures: 1 Sharp damage each. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
You never fight fair. Once per scene, as a free action, line up a cheap shot: your next attack this turn is upshifted once.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Use button: once per scene, marks you until the end of your turn. Your next attack is upshifted once and uses the mark up.

system.description:
You know your ride like your own hands. A vehicle you are driving has +1 Evasion and Edge on its Driving Tests.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: the vehicle you drive gets +1 Evasion, and its Driving Tests have Edge.

system.description:
You drive with one hand and aim with the other. A vehicle you are driving has Edge on its Targeting Tests.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: the vehicle you drive has Edge on its Targeting Tests (its weapons).

system.description:
Fires short, armor-piercing harpoons from its chestplate.

Sly Rax's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls against the targets and posts Apply Damage buttons (x degrees of success) and any Condition on a hit. Armor-piercing is up to the GM. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).
